# `mise bootstrap packages status`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap packages status [-J --json] [--missing]`
- **Aliases:** `ls`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/system/status.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/system/status.rs)

Show the state of packages from `[bootstrap.packages]`

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`--missing`** — Exit with status 1 if any package differs from the config (all are still listed)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

List every configured package and its state

```
mise bootstrap packages status
```

Print the state as JSON

```
mise bootstrap packages status --json
```

Exit with status 1 if any package differs from the config

```
mise bootstrap packages status --missing
```
